name: slider-range
title: Slider range
description: A price range with two thumbs, and the values shown beside it.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { Slider, SliderRange, SliderThumb, SliderTrack, } from '@/ui/slider/slider'; /** * A price filter with two thumbs that can't pass each other, and the * chosen range shown beside it. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-slider-range', imports: [Slider, SliderRange, SliderThumb, SliderTrack], template: `
Price {{ '$' + min() }} – {{ '$' + max() }}
`, }) export class SliderRangeExample { protected readonly min = signal(100); protected readonly max = signal(350); }
